name: Zalazane
summary: On the Echo Isles, dark magic has driven Zalazane mad and turned him against his tribe. Master Gadrin of Sen'jin Village calls Horde champions to end the witch doctor's rule. Zalazane enslaved his fellow tribesmen, seized the Darkspear trolls' rightful home, and drove them into exile on Durotar's coast.

sections.title: Betrayal on the Isles
sections.body: After fleeing their sunken island, the Darkspear followed Thrall across the Great Sea and settled on the Echo Isles, just off Durotar's southeast coast. Zalazane was once a respected and powerful witch doctor, but he hungered for power. His hexes enslaved the minds of his kin, and violence followed. Vol'jin led those who remained free, yet they were driven from their ancestral camps and forced to build a temporary refuge at Sen'jin Village.

sections.title: A Tribe's Torment
sections.body: From his hilltop stronghold on the largest Echo Isle, Zalazane still sends raiding parties across the channel. They seize more Darkspear and bring them under his control. The captured trolls become mindless voodoo and hexed thralls, lost to their tribe. Master Gadrin sees a threat to more than Darkspear land: Zalazane endangers the tribe's survival. Until his severed head is brought before the elders, no Darkspear can be safe.

aliases: who is the boss on echo isles
faq.answer: Zalazane was once a prominent witch doctor among the Darkspear trolls. Hunger for dark power corrupted him, and he turned on his kin, using mind-controlling voodoo to enslave them and seize the Echo Isles.

faq.q: Why did the Darkspear flee the Echo Isles?
aliases: why are trolls in sen'jin village
how did trolls lose echo isles
faq.answer: The Darkspear fled after Zalazane staged a surprise coup on the islands and used sorcery to turn their kin into mindless thralls. Vol'jin and the free Darkspear were too few to face their enchanted kin, so they retreated to mainland Durotar and founded Sen'jin Village as a temporary refuge.

faq.q: What happens to the trolls under Zalazane's control?
faq.answer: Hexes have robbed the trolls under Zalazane's control of their minds. They serve him, patrol the islands, and raid the mainland to capture more victims. Master Gadrin considers them lost to the tribe, with execution their only mercy.
Zalazane makes his lair on the largest Echo Isle, just east of Durotar's southern coast. He patrols from the high summit of its central hill down to the cluster of troll huts beneath it.

faq.q: Who gives the quest to kill Zalazane?
faq.answer: Master Gadrin, a tribal elder in Sen'jin Village on Durotar's southern shore, asks you to kill Zalazane. You meet him after handling local threats and arriving from the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: Why does Vol'jin not lead the assault himself?
faq.answer: Vol'jin rules the tribe and coordinates the Darkspear's defense alongside Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar. In Sen'jin Village, elders such as Master Gadrin guide local survival, and Gadrin enlists capable adventurers to strike back at Zalazane.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you have a personal duty to punish the betrayer who stole your people's home and enslaved your kin.
As a member of the Horde, you help defend the displaced Darkspear. Allies from across Durotar rally to their cause in one of the young Horde's first major tests of unity.
As a shaman, you know the spiritual crafts and primal powers practiced by troll shamans and witch doctors. Zalazane twists binding magic against his own kin.
